card.name: Words right before "response"
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected "response", such as "the", "its", a possessive 's, "will", or verbs like coordinate, responds and mounts. It also fires on "response" itself when it follows "the" in a reaction context.

modes.label: Slot before response
modes.description: A small word or verb where the next word is likely "response" or "reaction".
modes.example: A team from the Ministry of Health and Médecins sans Frontières (MSF) has gone to the affected province to coordinate<< the>> response.

modes.label: Body or system reacting
modes.description: Immune or bodily subjects with verbs of reacting, such as mounts or responds.
modes.example: Whatever the reason, the body<< mounts>> an inflammatory response in the colon as if

modes.label: Response after reactions
modes.description: The word response itself after "Should such reactions occur, the".
modes.example: Should such reactions occur, the<< response>> to each dose of midazolam

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word "response" or "responses" next.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to say "response", as in an immune response or a response to a dose.
